title: Phase 2: The Bible
use_cases: Configure when establishing a consistent rule set for terminology mapping
Use when transforming narrative structures to fit a specific genre requirement
Implement when maintaining logical consistency using a Sliding Window context
Use when merging scenes or removing narrative filler to improve story flow
content:
This is where the magic happens. We take that “Master Outline” (all the analysis from Phase 1), combine it with our Phase 0 summary and the user’s directives, and feed it to a “Narrative Architect” persona.

- The Output: This is a strict set of rules. It maps “John” to “ZEUS,” “Office” to “THRONE ROOM,” and “iPhone” to “Scroll”. It defines the global visual tone and the specific dialogue style guide for the new genre.
- The Goal: Create a single, consistent “Source of Truth” called the Transformation Bible.

Sometimes you want to do more than just swap words; you want to change the structure.

- The Context: To ensure the logic holds up, we use a “Sliding Window” of the last 5 beats.
- The Goal: Restructure the narrative flow, merging scenes or cutting filler, based on the new genre requirements.
